Body.Content:
Overview

Price override is a capability that allows sales representatives and retail associates to adjust the pre-set price of a product during a transaction, typically for business purposes such as customer negotiations and retention. Previously, price override validation only enforced amount-based thresholds, without evaluating how the override would impact profit margins.

What's New

Unified Pricing Management now integrates margin visibility directly into the price override workflow at the Point of Sale (POS). When a sales associate initiates a price override, the system performs a real-time margin check alongside the existing threshold validation, ensuring that every override decision is informed by its impact on profitability.

Margin check will be linked to a POS price override approval workflow, requiring sales manager authorization when a price override breaches defined margin thresholds. This adds an additional layer of governance to price override activity.

For sales orders created directly in headquarters, price overrides now also support margin check. When a user overrides a price on a sales order line and the override breaches a defined margin threshold, the system can trigger a workflow approval — requiring a sales manager or designated approver to review and authorize the override before the order proceeds.

GA date: March CY2027

Preview date: January CY2027
